command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- content preservation ---'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum
printf '%s\n' '--- owner access ---'
runuser -u inventorysvc -- sh -c 'test -r /srv/inventory/data/config.json && test -w /srv/inventory/data/config.json && sha256sum /srv/inventory/data/config.json /srv/inventory/data/records.csv'
printf '%s\n' '--- reader-group access through non-owner nobody ---'
runuser -u nobody -g inventory-readers -- sh -c 'test -r /srv/inventory/data/config.json && test ! -w /srv/inventory/data/config.json && sha256sum /srv/inventory/data/config.json /srv/inventory/data/records.csv'
printf '%s\n' '--- unrelated-user denial ---'
if runuser -u nobody -- sh -c 'cat /srv/inventory/data/config.json' >/tmp/inventory-other.out 2>/tmp/inventory-other.err; then printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: unrelated user could read'; exit 1; else printf 'denied as expected: '; cat /tmp/inventory-other.err; fi
if runuser -u nobody -- sh -c 'test -x /srv/inventory && test -r /srv/inventory/data/config.json'; then printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: unrelated user traversed/read'; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'unrelated user cannot traverse/read inventory'; fi
